name: Guncotton
description: Produce high explosive nitrocellulose from cotton and acids.

steps.success_message: The acids mix and heat up.
The cellulose reacts with the acid.
The product is washed clean of acid.
The guncotton is dry and ready.

name: Nitroglycerin
description: Produce powerful but unstable explosive from glycerol and acids.

steps.success_message: The nitrating mixture is ready.
Glycerol reacts to form nitroglycerin.
The nitroglycerin is washed.

name: Aqua Regia
description: Mix acids to create a solution that can dissolve gold.

steps.success_message: Aqua Regia is ready. It fumes orange.

name: Frost Bomb
description: Produce Ammonium Nitrate for use as an endothermic explosive.

steps.success_message: Ammonium nitrate solution formed.
Frost Bomb material is ready.

name: Hand Sanitizer
description: Produce hand sanitizer from ethanol, glycerol, and water.

steps.success_message: Ethanol and Glycerol are mixed.
Water is added to create the sanitizer gel.

name: Fulminate of Mercury
description: Produce primary explosive from mercury, nitric acid, and ethanol.

steps.success_message: Mercury dissolves in the acid.
Fulminate of Mercury crystals precipitate.
The crystals are washed clean.

name: Smelling Salts
description: Produce ammonium acetate as smelling salts from ammonia and acetic acid.

steps.success_message: The reaction produces smelling salts.

name: Health Potion
description: Synthesize a health potion from herbs and arcane essence.

steps.success_message: The herbs and essence fuse.
The potion is ready.

name: Hydrochloric Acid
description: Produce hydrochloric acid from salt and sulfuric acid.

steps.success_message: Hydrogen chloride gas is generated.
The gas dissolves to form Hydrochloric Acid.

name: Nitric Acid
description: Produce nitric acid from saltpeter and sulfuric acid.

steps.success_message: Nitric acid vapors condense.

name: Diethyl Ether
description: Produce diethyl ether from ethanol and sulfuric acid.

steps.success_message: Ether vapors are collected and condensed.

name: Sulfuric Acid
description: Burn brimstone, catalyse the fumes with saltpetre and drink them into water. The lead chamber process.

steps.success_message: The brimstone burns off to a choking gas.
The nitre takes up the gas and hands on its oxygen.
The vapours dissolve into a thin, hot acid.
Boiled down to oil of vitriol.

name: Ammonia
description: Drive the volatile alkali off sal ammoniac with a caustic. Spirit of hartshorn.

steps.success_message: The mixture begins to smell sharply.
The alkali is driven off as a gas.
Caught in water as spirit of hartshorn.

name: Sal Ammoniac
description: Neutralise the volatile alkali with spirit of salt and let the crystals grow.

steps.success_message: White fume where the two meet.
Fine white crystals of sal ammoniac.

name: Sugar of Lead
description: Dissolve litharge in vinegar. Sweet, soluble and thoroughly poisonous.

steps.success_message: The litharge goes slowly into the vinegar.
The liquor clears and sweetens.
The dross is left on the paper.
Needle crystals of sugar of lead.

name: Acetone
description: Dry-distil sugar of lead. The old spirit of Saturn.

steps.success_message: The salt darkens and begins to fume.
A clear, sweet-smelling spirit comes over.

name: Aspirin
description: Acetylate salicylic acid, quench, wash and dry. The first synthetic drug.

steps.success_message: The powder wets and slurries.
A few drops of acid set it going.
Held on the bath until the smell changes.
Quenched cold; needles crash out.
The crystals are collected.
Washed free of acid.
Dried to a white powder.

name: Ethyl Acetate
description: Fischer esterification: spirit and vinegar over an acid catalyst, then take the ester off the top.

steps.success_message: The two mix without complaint.
The catalyst goes in last.
Held at reflux; the smell turns to pear drops.
The ester comes over ahead of the rest.
Washed free of acid.

name: Methyl Salicylate
description: Esterify salicylic acid with wood spirit. Oil of wintergreen.

steps.success_message: The acid dissolves in the spirit.
The catalyst is added.
Refluxed until the wintergreen smell fills the room.
Washed to take the acid out.
A heavy, fragrant oil.

name: Chloroform
description: Chlorinate wood spirit and cut the trichloride out of the mixture.

steps.success_message: The spirit is turned to the chloride.
Chlorinated further, step by step.
The trichloride comes over sweet and dense.
Washed and dried over the last of the acid.

name: Kerosene
description: Take the lamp-oil cut off crude at the middle of the column.

steps.success_message: The crude is brought to a full boil.
The middle cut comes over clear.
Run through earth to take the colour out.

name: Naphtha
description: Take the light cut off crude, ahead of the lamp oil.

steps.success_message: The crude is brought up to temperature.
The lightest fraction comes over first.

name: Paraffin Wax
description: Solvent-dewax the heavy residue and chill the wax out of it.

steps.success_message: The residue is thinned with solvent.
Warmed until it runs freely.
Chilled; the wax cakes on the cloth.
The last of the solvent is driven off.

name: Glauber's Salt
description: Salt and oil of vitriol in the furnace. The spirit of salt goes up the flue; the cake is what is wanted.

steps.success_message: The salt hisses as the acid wets it.
Roasted to a hard white cake.
The cake is leached out.
Clear crystals of the salt mirabile.

name: Nitrobenzene
description: Mixed acid onto benzene, kept cold. Oil of mirbane.

steps.success_message: The mixed acid is made up and cooled.
Added slowly; the flask must not run away.
Held until the oil separates yellow.
Washed free of acid.
Dried and clarified.

name: Aniline
description: Reduce oil of mirbane over iron and acid. The parent of the coal-tar dyes.

steps.success_message: Iron filings are stirred into the oil.
The acid starts the reduction.
Held boiling; the mixture turns to sludge.
The base comes over with the steam.
Separated from the water.

name: Vitriol
description: Iron dissolved in oil of vitriol, crystallised green. Copperas.

steps.success_message: The iron fizzes and blackens the liquor.
Warmed until the metal is taken up.
The undissolved dross is left behind.
Pale green crystals form on cooling.

name: Potassium Nitrate
description: Work a nitre bed, leach it and crystallise the salt. Saltpetre, the way it was farmed.

steps.success_message: The bed is turned and left to work.
Leached, and the lye thrown on it.
The liquor is drawn off clear.
Long white needles of nitre.

name: Methanol
description: Destructive distillation of wood. Wood spirit, and it will blind you.

steps.success_message: The wood is charred in a closed retort.
A sharp, thin spirit comes over.
Rectified a second time.

name: Ethanol
description: Ferment the mash and rectify it until the spirit will burn clean.

steps.success_message: The mash is set to work.
Brought up to the spirit’s boil.
The low wines come over.
Rectified to a clean spirit.

name: Bone Black
description: Calcine bone in a closed retort. Char for filtering, and for making other things.

steps.success_message: The bone blackens without ever catching light.
Cooled and ground to a coarse black.

name: Prussian Blue
description: Fuse char with potash, throw the lye on copperas and watch it turn. Diesbach’s accident.

steps.success_message: Char and alkali are ground together.
Fused to a dark, evil-smelling melt.
The lye hits the copperas and goes deep blue.
The pigment is caught on the cloth.
Washed until the water runs clear.
Dried to a dense blue cake.

name: Lye Soap
description: Boil fat with caustic alkali, salt the soap out and press it. Saponification.

steps.success_message: The oil and the caustic are brought together.
Boiled until the mixture thickens and turns.
Salted; the soap rises and the lye drops.
The curd is skimmed off.
Pressed and left to harden.

name: Heavy Water
description: Cascade distillation of ordinary water. The heavy fraction is what is left at the bottom.

steps.success_message: The charge is brought to the boil.
The light water is taken off the top.
The bottoms are run through again.
And again. The residue is barely a spoonful.

name: Cinnabar
description: Grind quicksilver into brimstone and digest it in alkali until it reddens. Vermilion.

steps.success_message: Ground together to a black æthiops.
Digested in the alkali liquor.
Held warm; the black turns slowly scarlet.
Washed free of the liquor.
A deep red powder.

name: Liver of Sulfur
description: Fuse brimstone with potash. Hepar sulfuris, and it smells like it.

steps.success_message: Ground together in the mortar.
Fused to a red-brown liver.
Broken up and bottled tight.

name: White Phosphorus
description: Brand set out to make gold and found a cold fire instead. Retort the phosphate with char.

steps.success_message: The rock is broken down by the acid.
Char is worked into the paste.
The retort is brought to white heat.
A vapour comes over and condenses glowing.
Caught and kept under water, always.

name: Philosophical Salt
description: Calcine the body, leach the ash, and what will not burn again is the Salt. First of the tria prima.

steps.success_message: Burned to a white ash.
The ash is leached with warm water.
The insoluble earth is left behind.
The fixed Salt crystallises out.

name: Philosophical Mercury
description: Circulate the spirit over the Salt until nothing volatile is left in it. Second of the tria prima.

steps.success_message: The three are joined in the pelican.
Drawn over once.
And returned, and drawn again.
The seventh circulation. It runs quick and cold.
Clear, and heavier than it looks.

name: Philosophical Sulfur
description: Draw the oily, burning principle out of the resin. Third of the tria prima.

steps.success_message: Brimstone is ground into the resin.
Taken up in the sweet oil of vitriol.
Digested until the colour deepens.
The ether is drawn off and kept.
A red, oily Sulfur remains.

name: Alkahest
description: Van Helmont’s universal solvent: caustic alkali circulated with spirit until it will dissolve anything but glass.

steps.success_message: The caustic is taken up by the spirit.
Set to circulate in a closed vessel.
Drawn over; the residue is kept.
The Mercury is married into it.
Circulated again, and again, and again.
What comes through eats the paper.

name: Philosopher's Elixir
description: The Great Work: blacken, whiten, yellow and redden. Everything the bench knows, in one vessel.

steps.success_message: The Sulfur and the Mercury are conjoined.
Nigredo. The matter blackens and putrefies.
Albedo. Washed until it whitens.
Citrinitas. It yellows in the fire.
The Salt fixes it; the Alkahest opens it.
Rubedo. It goes red, and stays red.
A tincture, and very little of it.

name: Swift Wind Elixir
description: Herbs drawn in spirit and quickened with the Mercury.

steps.success_message: The herbs give up their virtue to the spirit.
Digested warm until the colour runs.
A drop of the Mercury, and it goes lively.
Strained bright.

name: Wisdom Elixir
description: Herbs, essence and the fixed Salt, drawn together and left to settle.

steps.success_message: A strong infusion is drawn.
The essence is stirred through it.
The Salt fixes what would otherwise fly off.
Concentrated to a clear, still liquor.
Bottled dark.

name: Dream Dust
description: An infusion taken to dryness over the Salt, and ground fine.

steps.success_message: Macerated cold, in the dark.
The Salt is worked in.
Taken gently to dryness.
Ground to a pale, shifting dust.

name: Vial of Miasma
description: Roast vermilion under brimstone and catch the fume in a solvent. Do not open it indoors.

steps.success_message: The red and the yellow are ground together.
Roasted; a heavy vapour lifts off it.
The fume is caught in the cold solvent.
Sealed while it is still cold.

name: Mana Potion
description: Essence opened with the Alkahest and carried in a shard-charged water.

steps.success_message: The essence disperses and the water lights.
The shard dissolves without residue.
Held until the glow steadies.
Bottled while it is still bright.

name: Acetaminophen Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Acetaminophen Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Aniline is acetylated to acetanilide.
Held hot while the ring is hydroxylated.
Washed of acid, twice.
Pressed into tablets. Kind to a fever, hard on a liver.

name: Calcium Antacid
description: Produce Calcium Antacid from Herb extract, Plant matter and Acidic Solution.

steps.success_message: Calcium Antacid is ready.

name: Bisacodyl Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Bisacodyl Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The aldehyde and the phenol are condensed.
Both ends are acetylated.
Washed until neutral.
Coated, so it survives the stomach.

name: Simethicone Drops
description: Produce Simethicone Drops from Herb extract, Oil Flask and Glass.

steps.success_message: Simethicone Drops is ready.

name: Loperamide Capsules
description: Bench synthesis of Loperamide Capsules, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The piperidine core is built.
The two aryl arms go on.
Washed of base.
Capsules, and a week of caution.

name: Bacitracin Ointment
description: Produce Bacitracin Ointment from Herb extract and Oil Flask.

steps.success_message: Bacitracin Ointment is ready.

name: Hydrocortisone Cream
description: Produce Hydrocortisone Cream from Herb extract, Oil Flask and Acidic Solution.

steps.success_message: Hydrocortisone Cream is ready.

name: Clotrimazole
description: Produce Clotrimazole from Herb extract and Acidic Solution.

steps.success_message: Clotrimazole is ready.

name: Electrolyte Powder
description: Produce Electrolyte Powder from Plant matter and Herb extract.

steps.success_message: Electrolyte Powder is ready.

name: Muscle Relaxant
description: Bench synthesis of Muscle Relaxant, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Guaiacol is freed from its salt.
The glyceryl ether is formed.
The syrup is filtered warm.
Bottled. It relaxes rather more than the muscle.

name: Medical Spray
description: Produce Medical Spray from Herb extract, Acidic Solution and Plastic Polymer.

steps.success_message: Medical Spray is ready.

name: Tranquilizer
description: Bench synthesis of Tranquilizer, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The benzophenone is assembled.
The diazepine ring is closed.
Washed of everything that is not the drug.
Tablets. Do not mix with drink.

name: Ibuprofen Capsules
description: Bench synthesis of Ibuprofen Capsules, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Isobutylbenzene, by alkylation.
Acylated at the para position.
Reduced, then carbonylated.
Capsules. Kinder to a stomach than aspirin, barely.

name: Regeneration Herb
description: Produce Regeneration Herb from Plant matter, Herb extract and Crystal.

steps.success_message: Regeneration Herb is ready.

name: Morphine
description: Produce Morphine from Herb extract, Acidic Solution and Glass.

steps.success_message: Morphine is ready.

name: Holy See's Remedy
description: Produce Holy See's Remedy from Herb extract, Crystal and Arcane Essence.

steps.success_message: Holy See's Remedy is ready.

name: Elixir of Varlenia
description: Produce Elixir of Varlenia from Herb extract, Crystal, Varlenia ore and Arcane Essence.

steps.success_message: Elixir of Varlenia is ready.

name: Dragon's Blood Elixir
description: Produce Dragon's Blood Elixir from Herb extract, Crystal, Arcane Essence and Bone.

steps.success_message: Dragon's Blood Elixir is ready.

name: Regeneration Nanites
description: Produce Regeneration Nanites from Herb extract, Quantum Core and Nanotube Module.

steps.success_message: Regeneration Nanites is ready.

name: Miracle Elixir
description: Produce Miracle Elixir from Herb extract, Crystal, Arcane Essence, Ethereal Shard and Varlenia ore.

steps.success_message: Miracle Elixir is ready.

name: Opium Tincture
description: Produce Opium Tincture from Herb extract and Ethanol.

steps.success_message: Opium Tincture is ready.

name: Minimum Vitality Tincture
description: Bench synthesis of Minimum Vitality Tincture, 2 steps.

steps.success_message: The mother tincture is made.
One dilution, and it is succussed.

name: Healing Droplets
description: Bench synthesis of Healing Droplets, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: The mother tincture is made.
First dilution.
Second dilution. The water is said to remember.

name: Vitality Essence
description: Bench synthesis of Vitality Essence, 2 steps.

steps.success_message: A crystal is added, for resonance.
One dilution.

name: Resonance Mist
description: Bench synthesis of Resonance Mist, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: A crystal is added, for resonance.
First dilution.
Second dilution, struck against leather each time.

name: Alignment Drops
description: Bench synthesis of Alignment Drops, 2 steps.

steps.success_message: A shard is dropped in and taken out again.
One dilution.

name: Ethereal Solution
description: Bench synthesis of Ethereal Solution, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: A shard is dropped in and taken out again.
First dilution.
Second dilution.

name: Vibrational Serum
description: Bench synthesis of Vibrational Serum, 2 steps.

steps.success_message: The core is held near the flask, not in it.
One dilution.

name: Quantum Elixir
description: Bench synthesis of Quantum Elixir, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The core is held near the flask, not in it.
First dilution.
Second dilution.
Third. There is now certainly nothing in it.

name: First Aid Kit
description: Bench synthesis of First Aid Kit, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Gauze is cut and soaked in spirit.
The dressings are dried and folded.
Everything goes into the tin.

name: Herbal Tonic
description: Bench synthesis of Herbal Tonic, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Nine plants go into the pot.
The pot is held just below a boil.
The liquor is strained through cloth.
Spirit is added so it keeps.

name: Field Medicine Kit
description: Bench synthesis of Field Medicine Kit, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Field dressings are prepared.
The sachets are filled.
Everything is dried before packing.
The kit is assembled in its tin.

name: Penicillin Course
description: Bench synthesis of Penicillin Course, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The culture is inoculated and set to grow.
Six days at blood heat. Nothing to do but wait.
The broth is filtered off the mould.
The antibiotic is thrown out of solution.
The powder is dried and pressed into tablets.

name: Doxycycline Course
description: Bench synthesis of Doxycycline Course, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The culture broth is acidified.
The ring is chlorinated under heat.
Acid is washed out of the product.
Yellow crystals, dried and counted.

name: Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics
description: Bench synthesis of Broad-Spectrum Antibiotics, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The nucleus is stripped for rebuilding.
A new side chain is hung on it.
The base is washed out.
Everything at once, in a capsule.

name: Vancomycin Vial
description: Bench synthesis of Vancomycin Vial, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The soil culture is fed and watched.
Ten days. This one cannot be hurried.
The broth is clarified.
The drug is taken up for infusion.
Sterile filtration into the vial.

name: Antiviral Capsules
description: Bench synthesis of Antiviral Capsules, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The sugar is protected before anything else.
The base is reduced onto it.
Salts are washed away.
The analogue is dried and encapsulated.

name: Interferon Course
description: Bench synthesis of Interferon Course, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The cell line is challenged and answers.
Three days in the incubator.
The supernatant is drawn off and clarified.
Stabilised, and straight into the cold.

name: Antiretroviral Regimen
description: Bench synthesis of Antiretroviral Regimen, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The sugar is chlorinated at one position.
The base is coupled on.
The second drug of the three is built alongside.
The batch is washed to pharmacopoeia.
Three drugs, dried and blistered together.

name: Antifungal Powder
description: Bench synthesis of Antifungal Powder, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Whitfield's proportions, to the letter.
Warmed until it goes clear.
Wax is folded in for the base.
Ground to a powder that will stay in a boot.

name: Amphotericin Drip
description: Bench synthesis of Amphotericin Drip, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The streptomycete is set to culture.
A week, and it smells like a cellar.
Clarified, twice.
Dissolved for the drip, which is the hard part.
Sterile filtration. Nothing else may go in.

name: Permethrin Lotion
description: Bench synthesis of Permethrin Lotion, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The flower heads are steeped in solvent.
The extract is pressed and strained.
The solvent is taken off and kept.
Made up into a lotion that will spread.

name: Delousing Kit
description: Bench synthesis of Delousing Kit, 2 steps.

steps.success_message: A shampoo nobody would use twice.
The comb is cut fine enough to be an insult.

name: Albendazole Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Albendazole Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The ring is nitrated.
Reduced back down to the amine.
The carbamate is closed onto it.
Two tablets, and something stops.

name: Vermifuge Draught
description: Bench synthesis of Vermifuge Draught, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Wormwood and tansy, by the almanac.
Held at a simmer until the colour goes.
Strained, and it still smells.

name: Metronidazole Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Metronidazole Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The imidazole is nitrated, carefully.
Held hot while the ring settles.
Acid off, or it is a poison.
Tablets, and no alcohol for a week.

name: Quinine Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Quinine Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Cinchona bark, freed from its salts.
The alkaloid moves into the solvent.
Pulled back out as the sulphate.
White needles. The ringing comes later.

name: Chloroquine Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Chloroquine Tablets, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The aniline is acylated first.
The quinoline ring is closed under heat.
The side chain is hung on.
Washed until the liquor runs clear.
Tablets. Weekly before, daily after.

name: Polyvalent Antitoxin
description: Bench synthesis of Polyvalent Antitoxin, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The toxoid is prepared at strength.
The horse answers over weeks, not hours.
The serum is drawn and clarified.
Preserved, and dated.

name: Rabies Immunoglobulin
description: Bench synthesis of Rabies Immunoglobulin, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Hyperimmune plasma is pooled.
Fractionated cold, and slowly.
Stabilised for the syringe.
Sterile filtration, then the clock starts.

name: Oral Rehydration Salts
description: Bench synthesis of Oral Rehydration Salts, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Salt and potash, weighed exactly.
Sugar and citrate go in.
Dried to a powder that will keep in a pocket.

name: Multivitamin Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Multivitamin Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Everything the diet forgot, extracted.
Strained and reduced.
Blended with the tabletting base.
Pressed into chalk. The urine goes bright.

name: Ascorbic Acid Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Ascorbic Acid Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The sugar is protected, the Reichstein way.
Oxidised under heat.
The lactone closes in acid.
Sour crystals. The Navy knew for a century.

name: B-Complex Injection
description: Bench synthesis of B-Complex Injection, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Yeast and liver, for the whole alphabet.
Clarified until it is fit for a vein.
Made up to injection strength.
Filtered sterile into the ampoule.

name: Cod Liver Oil
description: Bench synthesis of Cod Liver Oil, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Livers, and a great many of them.
Rendered gently, or it goes rancid.
The oil is separated off the solids.

name: Iron Sulphate Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Iron Sulphate Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Iron into vitriol, and it fizzes.
Held warm until nothing is left to dissolve.
The green liquor is filtered off the scale.
Pale green crystals, ground and tabletted.

name: Clotting Factor Vial
description: Bench synthesis of Clotting Factor Vial, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Plasma is pooled from a thousand donors.
Cryoprecipitated in the cold.
Stabilised, and never allowed to warm.
Freeze-dried into the vial.

name: Blood Transfusion Kit
description: Bench synthesis of Blood Transfusion Kit, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: The line and the cuff.
Cannula and bag, sterile packed.
Cross-matched and labelled with who gave it.

name: Insulin Vial
description: Bench synthesis of Insulin Vial, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Pancreas, minced into cold acid alcohol.
The extract is pressed and filtered.
Thrown out of solution at the right pH.
Made up to units and bottled cold.

name: Corticosteroid Course
description: Bench synthesis of Corticosteroid Course, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The sterol backbone is acetylated.
The ring system is rearranged under heat.
Oxidised at the corner that matters.
Washed clean of oxidant.
Tapered doses, counted out.

name: Immunosuppressant Course
description: Bench synthesis of Immunosuppressant Course, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The fungus is cultured for its peptide.
Six days, and the smell gets into your coat.
The broth is stripped and clarified.
Partitioned out of the mess.
Encapsulated. Bloods every fortnight.

name: Salbutamol Inhaler
description: Bench synthesis of Salbutamol Inhaler, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The aldehyde is reduced to the alcohol.
The amine is built onto the side chain.
Washed to inhalation grade.
Suspended and canned under pressure.

name: Beta-Blocker Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Beta-Blocker Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The naphthol is deprotonated.
The ether is opened onto it.
The amine closes the molecule.
Tablets. Never stop them abruptly.

name: Digitalis Tincture
description: Bench synthesis of Digitalis Tincture, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Foxglove leaf, and the dose is everything.
Warmed just enough to draw the glycoside.
Strained, and then counted in drops.

name: Anticonvulsant Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Anticonvulsant Tablets, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Benzil and urea, in the classic condensation.
The hydantoin ring closes.
Washed until neutral.
Tablets, and a blood level every month.

name: Antidepressant Course
description: Bench synthesis of Antidepressant Course, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The reuptake blocker is assembled.
The ether linkage is made.
Washed of solvent.
Six weeks before anything, and blister them.

name: Antipsychotic Course
description: Bench synthesis of Antipsychotic Course, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The phenothiazine is chlorinated.
The propylamine side chain goes on.
Washed of base.
Tablets, and the stiffness is the trade.

name: Lithium Carbonate Tablets
description: Bench synthesis of Lithium Carbonate Tablets, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: The salt is taken up and purified.
Filtered off the insolubles.
Recrystallised and pressed. The window is narrow.

name: Sedative Draught
description: Bench synthesis of Sedative Draught, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Valerian and hops, steeped cold.
A little ether, which is the old way.
Strained into a dark bottle.

name: Iodine Tincture
description: Bench synthesis of Iodine Tincture, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Iodine is liberated, violet and unmistakable.
The iodide is made up to hold it in solution.
Tinctured. It will stain for a week.

name: Debridement Kit
description: Bench synthesis of Debridement Kit, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Blades and forceps, sharpened and sterile.
Everything goes through the autoclave.
Packing and debriding agent.

name: Proton Pump Inhibitor
description: Bench synthesis of Proton Pump Inhibitor, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The pyridylmethyl chloride is made.
Coupled to the benzimidazole.
Oxidised to the sulphoxide, and no further.
Enteric coated, or the stomach eats it.

name: Blessed Water Phial
description: Bench synthesis of Blessed Water Phial, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Font water and salt, in the old proportion.
The blessing is spoken over it.
Decanted into the phial, which is always cold.

name: Rite of Exorcism Kit
description: Bench synthesis of Rite of Exorcism Kit, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Stole and candles, laid out in order.
Salt and chrism, blessed at the altar.
The relic goes in last, and the room gets cold.

name: Mana Purgative
description: Bench synthesis of Mana Purgative, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The universal solvent, cut until it is survivable.
Warmed until the channels in the flask ring.
Quicksilver of the philosophers, one drop.
Decanted. Everything will taste of copper.

name: Ley Cauterisation Salts
description: Bench synthesis of Ley Cauterisation Salts, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Salt and brimstone, ground together dry.
Saltpetre, so it will take a flame.
Calcined until it glows and stops.
Packed into a paper twist. Bite down on something.

name: Witch's Tincture
description: Bench synthesis of Witch's Tincture, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Nine herbs, and the resin nobody asks about.
Steeped in spirit at the same hour daily.
Drawn off slowly. Do not look at it in daylight.
Nine drops to the dose.

name: Debugging Nanites
description: Bench synthesis of Debugging Nanites, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The chassis is suspended and aligned.
Annealed until the lattice reports clean.
The instruction layer is written on.
Filtered to a swarm that will pass a needle.

name: Firewall Serum
description: Bench synthesis of Firewall Serum, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: The membrane is laid down a layer at a time.
The rules are keyed to the carrier.
Cured until the boundary holds.
Drawn into the syringe. Ask what was on the other side.

name: Null Salve
description: Bench synthesis of Null Salve, 3 steps.

steps.success_message: Quicksilver worked into a fat that will carry it.
Warmed until it stops reflecting anything.
Bodied into a salve. It smells of nothing at all.

name: Anchor Draught
description: Bench synthesis of Anchor Draught, 4 steps.

steps.success_message: Heavy water and the salt of the philosophers.
Held until the clock in the room agrees with itself.
Distilled somewhere with a floor.
Cut for drinking. Sit down first.

name: Panacea Draught
description: Bench synthesis of Panacea Draught, 5 steps.

steps.success_message: The three principles, in one vessel at last.
The work is held at heat and does not care that you are tired.
The spirit comes over clear and will not stop coming.
The solvent is fed in, and the flask goes quiet.
One dose. The exceptions are printed very small.
